issue.title: feat(r4g1): implement bounded integer-only repetition control (#79)
issue.body:
Fixes #79

This PR introduces bounded, allocation-free repetition control to `GraphScorer::score_candidates`.

### Implementation Details:
1. **Recency Window**: `score_candidates` and `score_candidates_legacy` now accept a bounded `recent_tokens` slice (max 32).
2. **Penalty Application**: Saturated `-2,000,000` logic is dynamically applied via `ScoreQ::from_raw` during cloud prediction for any token appearing in the recent context.
3. **Telemetry & Gate C**: 
   - A deterministic greedy simulation on the first 5 viable test seeds is performed inside `evaluate_gate_c`.
   - `repetition_rate_rule12` and `repetition_rate_baseline` are now properly serialized inside the `score_report.json` for downstream monitoring.

### Validation
Passes all unit and integration tests (zero regressions on Gate C accuracy). Verified that the runtime penalty applies seamlessly without triggering memory allocations.

Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/status_policy.rs | Update scorer calls to pass an empty recency window. | | tests/status_policy_common/mod.rs | Update helper scoring calls to pass an empty recency window. | | src/r4g1.rs | Keep status-policy scoring deterministic by passing empty `recent_tokens`. | | scripts/check_gate_c_regression.py | Add a CI-friendly regression check for Gate C trend output. | | crates/uor-r4-core/tests/score.rs | Update tests for new `score_candidates(sig, recent_tokens)` signature. | | crates/uor-r4-core/src/transformerless/score.rs | Add repetition-rate simulation + serialize repetition telemetry into score report. | | crates/uor-r4-core/src/transformerless/score_runtime.rs | Implement recency-window penalty in `GraphScorer::score_candidates` and parse fallback policy. | | crates/uor-r4-core/src/transformerless/resolution_status.rs | Add artifact-bytes decoding helpers for fallback policy/actions. | | .gitignore | Ignore `trend_output/` artifacts generated by CI trend tracking. | | .github/workflows/ci.yml | Add Gate C trend generation + regression checking + artifact upload. |

review_comments.body: `generate_greedy_repetition_rate` uses `.unwrap()` on `score_candidates`, which will panic the Gate C evaluation/CI trend job on any artifact/scoring error and lose the actionable error context. Prefer returning a `Result<f64, String>` from this helper and propagating it with `?` from `evaluate_gate_c`.

`recent_tokens` is documented/used as a bounded recency window (max 32), but `score_candidates` accepts any slice length and then does `contains()` checks per candidate. Clamping (or rejecting) longer inputs here makes the API safer and keeps the cost deterministically bounded.

`GraphScorer::fallback_policy` is introduced as a `pub` field but does not appear to be used outside `score_runtime.rs`. Exposing it publicly unnecessarily expands the API surface and locks in representation details; prefer `pub(crate)` (or a getter) until an external consumer is demonstrated.
